note: say: what the synthetic voice reads (spelled for pronunciation); text: the subtitle shown on screen

lines.say: Every six months, NASA's SPHEREx photographs the whole sky in infrared.
lines.text: Every six months, NASA’s SPHEREx photographs the whole sky in infrared.

lines.say: SEDNA turns those images into films, so whatever moves stands out.
lines.text: SEDNA turns those images into films, so whatever moves stands out.

lines.say: Pick a region, and SEDNA searches it for moving worlds. It finds Mah-kay-mah-kay on its own.
lines.text: Pick a region, and SEDNA searches it for moving worlds. It finds Makemake on its own.

lines.say: One knob turns its motion into a distance: forty-nine A-U. J-P-L says fifty-two.
lines.text: One knob turns its motion into a distance: 49 au. JPL says 52.

lines.say: Even Sedna, invisible in one image, appears when stacked along its orbit.
lines.text: Even 90377 Sedna, invisible in one image, appears when stacked along its orbit.
